title: Zeno v3.4.2 Desktop Notetaker
body:
## Zeno v3.4.2 Desktop Notetaker

Adds the new Desktop Notetaker section for continuous AI screen observation and note-taking while staying connected to Zeno's main chat.

### Highlights
- Desktop Notetaker section
- Configurable AI watch interval
- Custom watch/focus instructions
- Main-chat observation posting
- Unchanged-screen suppression before LM Studio analysis
- Multi-monitor selection
- Manual Analyze Now control
- Rolling observation history
- Passive observation only; Browser Agent remains responsible for actions
- Windows-first packaging with macOS/Linux-compatible mss capture layer

This is an upgrade pack for the newer modular Zeno line and does not replace the older monolithic 2.7.x source tree.
